title: Pancakes with Santa
seo_title: Pancakes with Santa in Lebanon, MO on Dec 5, 2026
description: Pancakes with Santa is a holiday morning with a free pancake breakfast, a free professional photo with Santa by Cherry Pic'd Photography, and a special gift for the kids. It takes place Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 8:30 AM to 10:30 AM at Big Whiskey;s, 2540 Granite Lane in Lebanon, Missouri. Admission is free.
